questions.text: Commerce is best defined as
options: the production of goods for sale
trade and the aids to trade
the exchange of goods for goods
questions.explanation: Commerce covers buying and selling together with the services that facilitate it, such as banking, insurance and transport.

questions.text: The exchange of goods for goods without the use of money is called
questions.explanation: Barter requires a double coincidence of wants, which is the main reason money replaced it.

questions.text: The aid to trade that protects a business against risk of loss is
questions.explanation: Insurance transfers risk to the insurer in return for a premium, based on the principle of indemnity.

questions.text: The principle of insurance which restores the insured to the position they were in before the loss is
questions.explanation: Indemnity prevents the insured from profiting from a loss; subrogation transfers salvage rights to the insurer.

questions.text: A distinguishing feature of a partnership is that
options: it has a separate legal personality
profits are shared according to an agreement
shares are quoted on the stock exchange
members have limited liability in all cases
questions.explanation: Partners share profits and losses as set out in the deed of partnership; most partners bear unlimited liability.

questions.text: The document sent by a seller to inform a buyer of the amount owed for goods supplied is the
questions.explanation: An invoice states the goods, quantities and amount payable; a receipt acknowledges payment already made.

questions.text: A credit note is issued by a seller when
options: the buyer returns goods or is overcharged
questions.explanation: The credit note reduces the amount owed by the buyer, typically for returns, damage or overcharge.

questions.text: A cheque crossed 'account payee only' must be
options: paid in cash over the counter
paid into the account of the named payee
questions.explanation: The crossing restricts negotiability, so the proceeds can only reach the named payee's account.

questions.text: The most suitable means of transporting bulky, low-value goods over a long distance within a country is
questions.explanation: Rail carries heavy bulk cargo cheaply over long inland distances, though it is slower and less flexible than road.

questions.text: A bonded warehouse is used to store goods on which
options: customs duty has not yet been paid
questions.explanation: Imported goods remain under customs control in a bonded warehouse until the duty is paid.

questions.text: Advertising that aims to keep an already well-known brand in the minds of consumers is
questions.explanation: Reminder advertising sustains awareness of a mature product rather than introducing or persuading.

questions.text: A major advantage of the supermarket over the small retail shop is
questions.explanation: Bulk purchasing lowers unit cost, allowing the supermarket to sell at competitive prices.

questions.text: The market where existing shares are bought and sold is the
questions.explanation: New issues are made in the primary market; the stock exchange is the secondary market for existing securities.

questions.text: The document that gives the holder title to goods being shipped is the
questions.explanation: The bill of lading is a receipt, a contract of carriage and a document of title all at once.

questions.text: A doctor treating patients in a hospital is engaged in
questions.explanation: Direct services are rendered personally to individuals; indirect services assist commerce and industry.

questions.text: The minimum number of persons required to form a private limited company in Nigeria is
questions.explanation: Under the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020, a single person may form a private company.

questions.text: An account that pays interest and is mainly used for keeping money for future use is a
questions.explanation: Savings accounts earn interest and allow withdrawals; current accounts are for frequent transactions and pay little or none.

questions.text: Which of the following is not a quality of good money?
questions.explanation: Money must keep its value over time, so perishability is a defect, not a quality.

questions.text: The fastest means of sending a written message to a customer abroad is by
questions.explanation: Electronic mail is delivered almost instantly and at negligible cost.

questions.text: A function performed by the wholesaler is
options: fixing the market price of all goods
questions.explanation: The wholesaler buys in large quantities and resells in smaller lots suited to the retailer's needs.

questions.text: The term C.I.F. in export trade means that the quoted price includes
questions.explanation: Under C.I.F. the exporter bears the cost of goods, marine insurance and freight to the named port.

questions.text: The main purpose of consumer protection laws is to
options: guard buyers against unfair trade practices
fix the wages of shop assistants
questions.explanation: Such laws address adulteration, false weights, misleading advertising and unsafe products.

questions.text: A short-term source of finance for a trading business is
questions.explanation: An overdraft allows a current account holder to draw beyond the balance for a short period.

questions.text: Under a hire purchase agreement, ownership of the goods passes to the buyer
options: when the first instalment is paid
after the final instalment is paid
questions.explanation: Until the last instalment, the buyer merely hires the goods, which is why they can be repossessed.

questions.text: Tourism contributes to the economy mainly by
options: earning foreign exchange and creating jobs
questions.explanation: Visitor spending brings in foreign currency and supports employment in hospitality and transport.

questions.text: The main aim of forming a cooperative society is to
options: maximise profit for a few members
promote the economic interest of members
questions.explanation: Cooperatives are member-owned and run for mutual benefit, with surpluses shared as dividends on patronage.
